basic_info.description: Beautifully updated home in the heart of Lakeshore, just moments from Lakeshore Elementary and Lowell High School. Filled with natural light, the home features a welcoming living room with fireplace, new flooring, and a formal dining area that flows easily for everyday living. Two spacious bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level.  Downstairs, a versatile bonus room and additional unwarranted bath offer flexible space for guests, work, or recreation. Located in one of San Francisco's most convenient neighborhoods, you're steps from Stonestown Galleria, restaurants, Stern Grove, Harding Park Golf Course, Lake Merced, Ocean Beach, and SF Statewith quick access to freeways and public transit.
